summary:
Space Mission Design, an interactive mission-planning game that transforms complex aerospace systems engineering into an engaging, accessible experience. Addressing the challenge of simulating end-to-end mission lifecycles, the game empowers players to either individually or local teams of up to four on a shared screen to step into the role of Mission Director. Players select high-priority science objectives, assign crew leadership, and engineer custom spacecraft by choosing compatible buses, launch vehicles, operational orbits, and scientific instruments.
To succeed, players must navigate genuine engineering trade-offs, balancing mass, power draw, communication bandwidth, budget, and operational lifetime against operational risk before running a dynamic mission simulation. and total science return.
This project is important because the multi-variable constraints into intuitive gameplay, Space Mission Design fosters scientific literacy, critical thinking, strategic experimentation, and collaborative problem-solving, inspiring players to discover what it truly takes to launch a successful voyage into deep space.
details:
Space Mission Design is a browser-based game developed and hosted on Replit. Players become Mission Directors and design a space mission by selecting a science objective, spacecraft bus, launch vehicle, orbit, and instruments. They must balance cost, mass, power, data, storage, mission lifetime, science return, and safety margins before running a simulation.

The game makes aerospace engineering accessible and engaging while promoting scientific literacy, critical thinking, experimentation, and teamwork. It supports solo play and local teams of up to four. Its creative approach transforms real mission trade-offs into intuitive choices through an interactive mission-control interface.
